## Goal
- Audit the Render release path end-to-end, prevent stale deployment evidence reuse, publish the IVX public-chat reliability fix, and provide verified live proof.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do not use or request the legacy static owner token.
- Preserve Supabase JWT owner authorization; do not weaken direct-owner controls.
- Keep signed server-to-server worker authorization separate: HMAC, expiring single-use owner approval, exact action/SHA binding.
- Never print, commit, or expose secret values.
- Public-chat policy blocks must return renderable HTTP `200` turns; authorization failures remain `401`/`403`; use `409` only for genuine state conflicts.
- Do not claim production deployment or verification without live evidence.
- Keep unrelated `.rork/history/main/*.json` and `ios-ivx-holdings/` work out of the backend release.

## Progress
### Done
- Local signed-deployment authorization implementation is complete:
  - `backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.ts` validates HMAC-SHA256 over worker ID, timestamp, nonce, method, path, and raw body.
  - Enforces five-minute clock skew, constant-time signature comparison, nonce replay prevention, exact approval/SHA/action binding, and single-use approval consumption.
- Local public-chat policy-block rendering fix is present:
  - `backend/api/public-chat.ts` persists feasibility blocks and returns a completed renderable HTTP `200` response.
  - `backend/services/ivx-public-chat-gate-response.ts` formats visible blocker responses.
- A valid Supabase owner JWT successfully authorized release job `ivx-worker-639a1564-5ea8-4f2c-8000-2997728b338a`:
  - Enqueue returned HTTP `202`.
  - Owner approval evidence: `ownerVerified:true`, `bearerAccepted:true`, `ownerEmailMatched:true`.
- The release job exposed the stale-proof defect:
  - Job reported `completed`, `finalStatus:"COMPLETE"`, `commitMatch:true`, and `healthOk:true`.
  - It reused old commit `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848` and old Render deployment `dep-d9hu14kfnr2s73anrtj0`.
  - Its stored goal explicitly requested a code-changing `BUG_FIX`, but it was classified/executed as `QA_ONLY`, with no changed files and no new commit.
  - This result was correctly rejected as release proof.
- Render audit completed:
  - API service is `ivx-holdings-platform`, ID `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`, type `web_service`, branch `main`, auto-deploy `yes`.
  - Render services include only the API web service and static sites; no separate `ivx-senior-dev-01` worker service exists.
  - Current live deployment remains `dep-d9hu14kfnr2s73anrtj0`, commit `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848`, trigger `api`.
  - Render environment variable names include `IVX_SENIOR_DEV_WORKER_ENABLED`, `GITHUB_TOKEN`, and production credential variables; values remained redacted.
- Confirmed stale production behavior independently:
  - GitHub `main` remains `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848`, message `release: publish validated IVX iOS source`.
  - Live `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/public/chat` with `{"message":"deploy now"}` still returns HTTP `409` and `{ "ok": false }`.
- Began local hardening against QA-only downgrade:
  - Added `resolveWorkerExecutionMode()` in `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`.
  - Owner-approved `approveGitDeploy:true` requests are now intended to force `executionMode:"deploy"`; approved patch-only requests force `executionMode:"code_change"`.
  - Added `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts` regression tests for mode precedence, including explicit `qa_only` downgrade prevention.
  - Updated `classifyTaskType()` in `backend/services/ivx-completion-validator.ts` so implementation keywords take precedence over verification/QA wording.
  - Added a regression case: `Fix the public chat response, deploy it, and verify the live endpoint`.

### In Progress
- Repair the local classifier change and its test suite, then validate the complete stale-proof prevention path.
- Confirm whether the deployed API’s in-process queue is the actual release executor or whether `backend/services/ivx-senior-dev-worker.ts` requires a separately provisioned Render worker.
- Commit and publish only the required chat/release-path backend files.
- Trigger a genuinely new Render deployment from a new GitHub SHA and verify the public-chat response live.

### Blocked
- No production deployment has occurred for the reviewed local chat or stale-proof fixes:
  - GitHub `main`, Render, and live API remain at `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848`.
  - Live public chat still returns HTTP `409` for `"deploy now"`.
- The newly run focused test command currently fails:
  - Command: `bun test backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts backend/services/ivx-completion-validator.test.ts backend/services/ivx-public-chat-gate-response.test.ts backend/services/ivx-pre-execution-feasibility-gate.test.ts backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.test.ts`
  - Failure: `Expected: "CODE_FIX" Received: "FEATURE"` at `backend/services/ivx-completion-validator.test.ts:39`.
  - Cause: the new classifier checks `add` as a feature signal before preserving an existing fix-first classification for `Fix the broken health route and add a regression test`.
- No Render service named `ivx-senior-dev-01` exists, despite `backend/workers/ivx-senior-dev-worker-entry.ts` defining a dedicated worker entry point.
- Full repository typecheck remains blocked by unrelated existing errors, including:
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(82,39): error TS2339: Property 'totalDistributions' does not exist on type 'AccountSummary'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(114,23): error TS2339: Property 'id' does not exist on type 'LedgerEntry'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts(7712,9): error TS2322: Type '"ivx_qa_only_runtime"' is not assignable...`
  - `backend/hono.ts(5059,28): error TS2554: Expected 2 arguments, but got 1.`

## Key Decisions
- Reject any release result that reuses an existing commit/deployment when the request required a code change.
- Do not treat health checks and SHA parity alone as proof of a patch release; proof must include a newly committed reviewed SHA, changed-file evidence, a corresponding Render deployment, and live endpoint verification.
- Force execution mode from approved mutation flags at the owner API boundary:
  - `approveGitDeploy:true` → `deploy`
  - `approvePatch:true` without deploy approval → `code_change`
  - An explicit `qa_only` request cannot downgrade an owner-approved production mutation.
- Keep direct human owner actions guarded by Supabase owner JWT; HMAC remains internal-worker-only.
- Keep production secrets private in Render; environment inspection may record names/presence but never values.

## Next Steps
1. Fix `classifyTaskType()` so a fix request with an added regression test remains `CODE_FIX`/`UI_FIX`, not `FEATURE`.
2. Re-run the focused command:
   - `bun test backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts backend/services/ivx-completion-validator.test.ts backend/services/ivx-public-chat-gate-response.test.ts backend/services/ivx-pre-execution-feasibility-gate.test.ts backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.test.ts`
3. Inspect `summarizeAutonomousCoderProof()` and terminal completion guards in `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`; require code-change/deploy jobs to fail rather than complete when no new commit/change exists.
4. Add focused regression coverage for rejecting reused `commitSha`/`deployId` evidence on code-changing jobs.
5. Commit only the repaired backend chat/release-path files; exclude `.rork/history/main/*.json` and unrelated source.
6. Push the reviewed commit to `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest` `main`.
7. Poll Render service `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0` until a new deployment is `live` on the new GitHub SHA.
8. Verify GitHub SHA, Render deployment commit, production health, and runtime version parity.
9. Probe live `POST /api/public/chat` with `{"message":"deploy now"}` and require HTTP `200`, `ok:true`, and a non-empty visible `answer`.
10. Record the new commit SHA, deployment ID, focused test results, health result, and public-chat response in `.rork/plans/force-sync-ivx-workspace-and-release-eve_1784928084433.plan.md`.
11. Provision or identify the actual autonomous worker hosting path and configure matching private `IVX_INTERNAL_DEPLOY_SECRET` / `IVX_INTERNAL_WORKER_ID` only if the dedicated worker implementation is required.
